task_name: One line per issue of the milestone
summary: Added SliceLine/MilestoneProgress value objects and the ReadMilestoneProgress query: it reads the held session's frozen spec and issue listing (progress: null for a missing/draft spec, without reading issues), then builds one SliceLine per issue — closed issue or work.condition 'finished' -> delivered (pull request from the harvest when available); WorkNotFound on an open issue -> pending; 'planning' -> running with step 'planning' and stepStartedAt = nowMs()-runningMs while the plan call runs, else null; 'implementing' -> running with task/totalTasks/pullRequest from ImplementationState and stepStartedAt as the later of the current call's startedAt and the latest history entry's writtenAt; 'uncertain' -> needs-person from its execution state. A PlanFailure from PlanningActivities/ImplementationActivities is caught and leaves lastToolCall/lastText null without failing the read (per plan decision); any other PlanFailure (e.g. from ImplementationHistory) propagates. TDD: wrote all 7 named tests first, watched them fail on the missing module, implemented, then verified both declared commands green. Mutation sweep found and closed real gaps beyond the plan's own list: (1) strengthened 'a history entry later than the current call starts the current step' to use two entries (one earlier, one later) since a single entry could not distinguish 'pick the max' from 'pick the only one'; (2) the 'planning' phase branch was completely unexercised by the plan's 7 named tests (a thrown Error there still left all 7 green), so I added two tests, 'a planning slice answers the plan step and its call start' and 'a planning slice with a finished planning activity has no current step start', covering both halves of the plan-step decision's own ternary. All three additions are pure test-file additions inside the already-declared __tests__/application/read-milestone-progress.test.ts; no production file gained code that these tests do not exercise. The full backend suite (npx vitest run) shows 3337/3340 passing; the 3 failures are all in the unrelated __tests__/infrastructure/run-driver-runtime-real-process.test.ts (gh/claude real-subprocess flakiness matching the milestone context's documented 'CT_STATE_DIR disagreement'-class environmental caveat) and I confirmed that file has zero reference to any file this task touched.
